goal: RA-8375: worktree-mode session start works from any Pi-Dev-Ops checkout on any machine. The WorktreeCreate and WorktreeRemove hooks call .claude/hooks/worktree_hook.py, which reads the event from standard input; tests in the repo reproduce the old failure and pass on the new script; the repo itself ignores .claude/worktrees/ (until now only this Mac's local exclude file did); the change holds only the script, the two hook lines, the ignore rule, the tests and this contract.

criteria.text: The worktree hook tests pass, together with the existing class guards that run every registered hook (no hook exits 2 when its script is missing; missing targets stay quiet).

Since its merge base with main the branch changes exactly these files and no others: the hook script, the settings file, .gitignore, the new test file, and the two Done contract folders for this work (the first contract and this revision).

criteria.text: The settings file no longer reads WORKTREE_DIR or WORKTREE_BRANCH, the two variables Claude Code never sets.
The suite keeps tests that run the old hook lines against Claude Code's real input and require them to fail, so the reason for the fix stays reproducible.
The new script and test file pass the repository's lint.
The repository's own .gitignore ignores .claude/worktrees/, so a worktree made by the hook does not show as an untracked folder on a machine without this Mac's local exclude file.
